title: Aftertalk on my Cruise Vacation (F4A (Aftertalk))
description: A short aftertalk taken from the end of my file, "Inhaled Experience", so you can place it after listening to my other files as well. It's just something soft and gentle to put on, and listen to me ramble about my upcoming vacation and my love of horseback riding. Sometimes the familiar heady sounds of my voice are all that you need to melt away any lasting cares and worries from some of my more harsher experiences. Hm. How do you feel? Don't worry. You don't have to get up just yet. I don't really think there is anything more important right now. Just enjoy how you feel. I'll stay with you a moment. Talk with you. I was considering fucking with you. Saying spacey things to play with your high brain, but I think you're coasting just fine on the endorphins from our time together. So instead I'm going to tell you a little bit about my vacation. You'll be good and listen, won't you?
author: Mistress Shibby
